    Twisted lifts satisfy the lifting identities (toward Proposition 12.8) #

    If a family of lifted actions (assocErr) or of lifted maps (interErr) built at the fibre t = 1 has all relative weights in the cone, then the twisted family satisfies the same identities for the twisted deformation at every parameter t: on the torus the twist is conjugation by the diagonal scalings, and the identities are polynomial in t (IsPoly.eq_zero_of_torus).
